description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Notifying that the mid year Fiscal Position Report 2016 is available for inspection
reasoning: This gazette notification announces the availability of the Mid Year Fiscal Position Report 2016, issued under the Fiscal Management (Responsibility) Act, No. 03 of 2003. The content primarily concerns a regulatory/compliance matter (publishing a fiscal report as required by law) rather than government personnel changes, structural changes, or any other specialized category. It falls under Legal/Regulatory as it involves statutory instruments and compliance with existing legislation.
